{{Quote|The Republic's using the rocket tram's green line to run fresh troops and supplies across Coronet City. The Empire wants that tram derailed. I've got the bombs built, but no way of getting to the tracks and setting them up. The Republic's got squads and snipers patrolling the entire line.|[[Kapp Zyman]]|<ref name="Derailing the Rocket Tram">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Derailing the Rocket Tram|Corellia}}</ref>}}
[[File:Green_line.png|thumb|right|200px|The green line]]
The '''green line''' was one of the [[rocket tram]] lines that served [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. It was destroyed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]], depriving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] of a vital route into Coronet.
